steps.skipped: The Tasks module keeps no plan fingerprint (no PlanState/PlanChanged). The plan returns the ETag of the task and the confirmed call carries it: when the task changed in between, the ETag no longer matches and the call is refused as a conflict, without a new plan (asserted outside the golden); the CalDAV write itself carries the read ETag as If-Match.
